raw_text: BREAKING: President Erdogan calls on OIC nations to take collective action on Kashmir. 'We cannot remain silent while millions suffer under occupation.' Full coverage on TRT World tonight. India's representative walks out of session. #OICSummit #Kashmir #FreedomForKashmir
